arxiv-2302-07054.title: Compression and information entropy of binary strings from the collision history of three hard balls Journal: Journal of Physics Communications
arxiv-2302-07054.creator: M. Vedak, G. J. Ackland
arxiv-2302-07054.description: Abstract We investigate how to measure and define the entropy of a simple chaotic system, three hard spheres on a ring. A novel approach is presented, which does not assume the ergodic hypothesis. It consists of transforming the particles’ collision history into a sequence of binary digits.

arxiv-2307-10356.title: A new vista on the Heterotic Moduli Space from Six and Three Dimensions Preprint: UUITP-23/23 Preprint: NORDITA 2023-109
arxiv-2307-10356.creator: Michele Del Zotto, Marco Fazzi, Suvendu Giri
arxiv-2307-10356.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Michele Del Zotto, Marco Fazzi, Suvendu Giri. We settle a long-standing question about the hypermultiplet moduli spaces of the heterotic strings on ALE singularities. These heterotic backgrounds are specified by the singularity type, an instanton number, and a (nontrivial) flat connection at infinity. Building on their interpretation as six-dimensional theories, we determine a class of three-dimensional 𝒩 = 4 \mathcal{N}=4 quiver gauge theories whose quantum corrected Coulomb branch coincides with the exact heterotic hypermultiplet moduli space.

arxiv-2510-00535.title: Noncoincidence f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) -Cosmology with Dark Matter Coupled to Gravity
arxiv-2510-00535.creator: A. Abebe, P.S. Apostolopoulos, A. Giacomini, G. Leon, F. Moncada, A. Paliathanasis
arxiv-2510-00535.description: Abstract We investigate FLRW cosmology in the framework of symmetric teleparallel f ⁡ ( Q ) f(Q) gravity with a nonminimal coupling between dark matter and the gravitational field. In the noncoincidence gauge, the field equations admit an equivalent multi-scalar field representation, which we investigate the phase-space using the Hubble-normalization approach.

arxiv-2512-18495.title: Enhancing Decision-Making in Windows PE Malware Classification During Dataset Shifts with Uncertainty Estimation
arxiv-2512-18495.creator: Rahul Yumlembam, Biju Issac, Seibu Mary Jacob
arxiv-2512-18495.description: Abstract Artificial intelligence techniques have achieved strong performance in classifying Windows Portable Executable (PE) malware, but their reliability often degrades under dataset shifts, leading to misclassifications with severe security consequences. To address this, we enhance an existing LightGBM (LGBM) malware detector by integrating Neural Networks (NN), PriorNet, and Neural Network Ensembles, evaluated across three benchmark datasets: EMBER, BODMAS, and UCSB.

pmc-10617337.description: In this retrospective study, we measured enterovirus D68 (EV-D68) genomic RNA in wastewater solids longitudinally at 2 California, USA, wastewater treatment plants twice per week for 26 months. EV-D68 RNA was undetectable except when concentrations increased from mid-July to mid-December 2022, which coincided with a peak in confirmed EV-D68 cases.

pmc-11419736.creator: Teng Huei Lee, Ramiza Ramza Ramli
pmc-11419736.description: Isolated sphenoid sinusitis (ISS) is a rare but potentially serious condition, often leading to severe complications due to delayed diagnosis and treatment. This case report discusses a 75-year-old male with type 2 diabetes mellitus who presented with severe left-sided headache and neck pain.

pmc-11494865.title: Home-based guidance training system with interactive visual feedback using kinect on stroke survivors with moderate to severe motor impairment

pmc-12634350.title: Autologous platelet-rich gel versus vitamin B12 for the treatment of grade III-IV acute radiation dermatitis in malignant tumor patients undergoing radiotherapy: an open-label randomized controlled clinical trial

pmc-12655298.title: Age-Related Anabolic Resistance: Nutritional and Exercise Strategies, and Potential Relevance to Life-Long Exercisers
pmc-12655298.creator: Íñigo M. Pérez-Castillo, Ricardo Rueda, Suzette L. Pereira, Hakim Bouzamondo, José López-Chicharro, Felipe Segura-Ortiz, Philip J. Atherton
pmc-12655298.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Anabolic resistance, consisting of a diminished ability of aging muscle to respond to anabolic stimuli such as exercise and protein intake, is a key contributor to age-related declines in muscle mass. However, diseases and lifestyle factors associated with aging, including insulin resistance states, overweight/obesity, persistent inflammation and specifically—as a focus herein—physical inactivity and inadequate dietary protein-intake habits, might interact with chronological impairments in muscle anabolism.

pmc-13036614.creator: Gürkan Ünsal, Ahmet Faruk Ertürk, Elif Meltem Aslan, Marco Di Blasio, Diana Russo, Gabriele Cervino, Maria Maddalena Marrapodi, Giuseppe Minervini

pmc-13292412.title: Beyond the Numbers: Frailty as a Therapeutic Target in CKD
pmc-13292412.creator: Rajesh Raj
pmc-13292412.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). , and is subjective in its early stages (e.g., self-reported exhaustion). Yet, despite its prognostic significance, frailty in chronic kidney disease (CKD) has rarely been considered a serious therapeutic target.1 In this journal, the article by Chang et al.2 describes a randomized trial in which an individualized, multicomponent program reduced frailty in nearly one-third of 242 older adults with nondialysis CKD—a 4-fold increase in frailty reversion over routine care. The findings challenge the deeper assumption that frailty is largely irreversible.

Hollow glass microspheres (HGMs) are used as particulate fillers to manufacture syntactic foam composites. The standard thermosetting resins have a recommended set of 3D printing parameters.

pmc-13585620.title: Vertebral artery pseudoaneurysm with recurrent posterior circulation transient ischemic attacks in a post-radiotherapy nasopharyngeal carcinoma survivor: a case report
pmc-13585620.creator: Haitao Hu, Rui Shang, Yuhu Ma, Meng Ji, Ting Wang, Zexu Wang, Changwei Zhang
pmc-13585620.description: BackgroundRadiation-induced osteosarcoma (RIOS), osteoradionecrosis (ORN), and post-radiotherapy pseudoaneurysms are recognized late complications of radiotherapy for nasopharyngeal carcinoma (NPC). Although post-radiotherapy pseudoaneurysms usually present with life-threatening hemorrhage, associated ischemic manifestations are rarely described.Case presentationA 50-year-old man with a history of NPC treated with radiotherapy developed a left cervical paravertebral RIOS 15 years later, with suspected coexisting cervical spine osteoradionecrosis (C-ORN).

Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) Definitions In this section: (1) Importer The term “importer” means any person who, for purposes of resale, transports into the United States puppies from a foreign country.
